hook.en: Two people who speak different languages cannot talk. Two computers need a shared language too: a protocol. Different jobs, like sending mail or loading a page, use different protocols.
hook.kn: ಬೇರೆ ಭಾಷೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುವ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸಂವಹಿಸಲಾರರು. ಎರಡು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಭಾಷೆ ಬೇಕು: ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ. ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವುದು, ಪುಟ ತೆರೆಯುವುದು ಮುಂತಾದ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರಗಳು.

objectives.en: Describe HTTP, FTP, PPP, SMTP and TCP/IP

narration.en: Two people who speak different languages cannot talk. Two computers need a shared language too: a protocol. Different jobs, like sending mail or loading a page, use different protocols.
narration.kn: ಬೇರೆ ಭಾಷೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುವ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸಂವಹಿಸಲಾರರು. ಎರಡು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಭಾಷೆ ಬೇಕು: ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ. ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವುದು, ಪುಟ ತೆರೆಯುವುದು ಮುಂತಾದ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರಗಳು.

body.en: A protocol is a set of standard rules that sender and receiver follow so that they can communicate correctly. Protocols define the format of data, how errors are detected, how fast to send (flow control) and how to start and end communication. Devices made by different companies can talk to each other only because they follow the same protocols.

narration.en: Protocols are agreed rules for communication. They fix the data format, error checking and speed, so devices from different makers can work together.
narration.kn: ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರಗಳು ಸಂವಹನದ ಒಪ್ಪಿತ ನಿಯಮಗಳು. ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ರೂಪ, ದೋಷ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ವೇಗವನ್ನು ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿ ಬೇರೆ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳ ಸಾಧನಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: HTTP, FTP, PPP, SMTP and TCP/IP

body.en: HTTP: transfers web pages between browser (client) and web server using requests and responses. FTP: transfers files between a client and a server. PPP: connects two nodes directly (point to point), e.g. a computer to an ISP, with authentication. SMTP: sends e-mail from client to server and between mail servers. TCP/IP: the Internet's core suite; TCP breaks messages into packets and reassembles them reliably and in order, while IP gives addresses and routes each packet.

points.en: PPP: direct link between two nodes
TCP: reliable packets; IP: addressing and routing

narration.en: HTTP is for web pages, FTP for files, PPP for a direct link between two nodes, SMTP for sending mail, and TCP/IP carries everything on the Internet.
narration.kn: HTTP ಜಾಲಪುಟಗಳಿಗೆ, FTP ಕಡತಗಳಿಗೆ, PPP ಎರಡು ನೋಡ್‌ಗಳ ನೇರ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ, SMTP ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲು, TCP/IP ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲದ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Name the protocol used in each step: (i) Asha opens a college website, (ii) she e-mails her project to her lecturer, (iii) the lecturer uploads results to the college server, (iv) every one of these messages is split into packets and routed.

steps.en: (i) Fetching a web page → HTTP (HTTPS when secure).
(iii) Uploading a file to a server → FTP.
(iv) Packets and routing underneath everything → TCP/IP.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ ಸಂವಹನದ ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಗುಂಪು. HTTP: ವೆಬ್; FTP: ಕಡತ; SMTP: ಮೇಲ್; PPP: ನೇರ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ. TCP ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ ವಿತರಣೆ; IP ವಿಳಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರ್ಗ.
